notes: The tuition figure is the "Tuition fee / semester * for non-EU applicants **" of the Tourism and Catering BSc row, 2450 EUR per semester. Page footnotes add payment conditions: three semesters in advance for Bangladesh, Syria, Yemen applicants, and first two semesters payable in advance by the deadline in the Conditional Letter of Acceptance for applicants under *** (footnote applies to programmes marked ***; the Tourism and Catering row is marked ***). Both footnotes are exceptions with country- or programme-dependent conditions; a human should confirm which applies to a Moroccan applicant. The programme's own page was not supplied; the fee table page (node/319) and the application procedure page (node/30) were used.
